# One dataset, two ways to query it

Answer bakery sales questions in **SQL** and with **Polars expressions**, then compare the results.
:::

[Download the bakery SQL + Polars notebook](../notebooks/lab-03-bakery-sql-polars.ipynb){download="lab-03-bakery-sql-polars.ipynb" .btn .btn-primary}

Open it in Jupyter or another Python notebook environment. The first run needs internet access to download the synthetic dataset and any missing packages; setup details are in the notebook.

Work alone or with others. Compare your SQL and Polars results as you go, and if you work alone, compare a result with a classmate. Turn in the notebook with what you finish; Canvas will specify submission details.
